briefing: Markets drifted slightly lower today (NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.6%) on no clear catalyst, so this is a neutral, not risk-on, session. We're holding all existing positions and adding only SMMT, the single candidate with full multi-signal confirmation, rather than forcing capital into the other open slots.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confirmation means waiting for multiple independent signals — like RSI, MACD, price versus moving averages, and volume — to all line up before trusting a stock's momentum. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when four signals agree, it suggests real buying interest rather than a random price blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術確認是指在信任一隻股票的動力之前，等待多個獨立訊號（例如RSI、MACD、股價相對均線位置及成交量）同時出現一致方向。單一利好訊號可能只是雜訊，但當四個訊號同時吻合時，就更能反映真實的買盤興趣，而非隨機的價格波動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indexes slipped modestly today with NASDAQ down 0.8% and the S&P 500 down 0.6%, a broad, low-conviction pullback rather than a reaction to any single major headline. Trading stayed choppy across sectors without a clear risk-on or risk-off theme emerging. In the absence of major news catalysts, price action looks more like routine consolidation after recent gains than the start of a deeper correction.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大型指數普遍小幅走低，納斯達克下跌0.8%，標普500下跌0.6%，屬於廣泛而缺乏明確方向的回調，並非由單一重大消息觸發。各板塊交投反覆，未見明顯的風險偏好或避險主軸。在缺乏重大消息催化的情況下，這次表現較像近期升勢後的例行整固，而非深度調整的開端。

trades.reasoning: SMMT is the only candidate showing all four confirming signals (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge), meeting the multi-signal bar for high-conviction buys even as the broader market drifts slightly lower.
